scope: PRODUCT_OUTCOME: All substantive unique Symphony histories in the execution-start inventory are reconciled without destructive rewriting; exact candidate version 0.2.2 is merged to main and published once as an immutable four-platform GitHub/Burrito release whose commit, checksums and clean-install smoke behavior are durably verified.

EXPECTED_OUTCOME: One provenance-complete, reviewed and exact-SHA-evidenced candidate converges with governed PR merge, main SHA, unused tag v0.2.2, GitHub Release metadata, four binaries, four SHA-256 files and post-publication verification receipts.

REPOSITORY: projectId=bos; repositoryId=symphony; owner/repo=acancelas/symphony; mutation boundary is this repository only; acancelas/bos-mcp Goal 216 is read-only cross-repository coordination context.

CAPABILITY: cap-symphony-consolidated-immutable-release — Consolidate Symphony and publish one verified immutable release; risk=high; autonomy=full; sole executable issue=issue-60-reconcile-verify-publish mapped to GitHub Issue 60.

ISSUE: issue-60-reconcile-verify-publish — ordered gates are inventory, integration, candidate version/release hardening, exact-SHA assurance, and governed merge/tag/release/artifact verification; autonomy=full; risk=high.

DEPENDENCIES: No peer Issue dependency because Issue 60 is the sole executable item; mandatory internal handoff chain is inventory ledger -> disposition-complete integration/provenance map -> 0.2.2 hardened candidate -> pushed exact-SHA validations/reviews/evidence -> governed PR merge -> unused tag/release -> post-publication artifact verification.
CROSS_CAPABILITY_DEPENDENCIES: None because there is exactly one capability; central Goal 216 supplies coordination only and does not authorize or require sibling-repository mutation.

SCOPE_INVENTORY: At one immutable execution-start cutoff record timestamp, origin/main SHA, all local Symphony worktree roots, local refs, origin refs and tips, ahead/behind counts, dirty/untracked/unreadable status, and unique commits in a durable run artifact.

SCOPE_DISPOSITION: Account for every inventory entry as substantive-integrate, already-equivalent, superseded-with-exact-evidence, duplicate, generated/audit-only, or Goal-excluded with source identity and rationale; later-created refs are outside the frozen universe unless a scope change is approved.

SCOPE_INTEGRATION: Integrate every substantive history onto the Issue 60 branch with ordinary non-forced Git operations; preserve source refs/worktrees/untracked data; resolve semantic overlap across orchestrator, GameApiTrackerAdapter, outbox/audit, Goal authorization, workspace recovery, cancellation/subprocess, telemetry, dashboard, tracker and release paths while retaining AGENTS.md contracts.

SCOPE_RELEASE_HARDENING: Before exact-SHA validation set elixir/mix.exs to unused next SemVer 0.2.2 and change .github/workflows/burrito-release.yml to fail if tag, release or assets already exist and never use gh release upload --clobber.

SCOPE_ASSURANCE: Push candidate normally; bind all checks/reviews/evidence to exact SHA; run inexpensive targeted and spec checks first, then cd elixir && mise exec -- mix test as required by .bos/project.yaml, then repository make all/full gates, clean-tree/upstream-reachability, release workflow tests, owned-child process leak scan, and four-platform Burrito build/smoke evidence.

SCOPE_DELIVERY: Through bos-mcp/game-api only, create/recover governed PR, require exact-head checks/evidence/reviews, merge without bypass, confirm merged main SHA, reserve/create unused immutable v0.2.2 tag/release once, and verify published binaries/checksum files/checksums/clean-install smoke behavior.

EXCLUSIONS: No new work items, sibling-repository mutations, destructive cleanup, deletion of worktrees/refs/commits/untracked data, overwrite of unrelated changes, force-push/reset/history rewrite, direct GitHub API/gh Delivery operations outside the governed release workflow, credential exposure, stale-SHA evidence, check bypass, tag reuse, asset replacement, unrelated expansion or acceptance weakening.

EXCLUSIONS_RUNTIME: No daemon/server/browser deployment is claimed because .bos/project.yaml and BOS context provide no provider target, server/project ID, URL, version/health oracle or rollback reference; the canonical production outcome is the configured GitHub/Burrito artifact release. Discovery of a pre-existing canonical runtime target pauses for a versioned scope decision.

ACCEPTANCE_INVENTORY: Durable cutoff ledger represents every in-universe worktree/ref and every unique history has exact identity, disposition and rationale; substantive entries are integrated/equivalent/superseded with evidence and no source state is destroyed.

ACCEPTANCE_CANDIDATE: Exact clean pushed candidate contains 0.2.2 and fail-closed no-clobber release behavior; targeted/spec/required mix test/make all/security-boundary/subprocess/release checks pass and candidate HEAD is confirmed by upstream.

ACCEPTANCE_REVIEWS: Functional/quality plus architecture/security reviewers always pass on exact candidate; concurrency/recovery reviewer is required if scheduler/outbox/workspace/cancellation paths change; release reviewer is always required; visual/browser reviewer is required only when both a UI change and configured browser target exist.

ACCEPTANCE_DELIVERY: Governed PR merges exact reviewed/evidenced candidate without bypass; tag/release v0.2.2 and merged main converge on same commit; all linux_x86_64, linux_arm64, macos_x86_64 and macos_arm64 binaries and SHA-256 files exist, hashes match and clean-install smoke passes; BOS receipts cover every boundary.

ROLLBACK_POLICY: Before merge, repair by forward commit on issue branch. After merge but before tag, repair by a new governed PR. No server rollback exists because no runtime target is configured.
